title: Three Shifts and One Short Rope
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：strategy　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 strategy 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the foreman ① made the strategy that no worker in the site would have measured, and he said the making was the whole of the shift. The ② strategy, meaning the plan itself and not the rope, ran three shifts and stayed unmeasured in the book; a strategy, he said, is the only thing in a site that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ strategy in that site had the same short rope beside it, and the ④ strategy at the far ramp, meaning the load they kept for the children to lift and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A strategy, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the foreman said the measuring is the part that fills three shifts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the strategy was the whole of the matter, meaning the wisdom and not the plan. The ⑥ strategy, meaning the wisdom and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; strategy, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a plan and a wisdom. He said the wisdom is the part they remember.

By 1980 the ⑦ strategy had become a line in a sheet, and the sheet had become an argument about the short rope. The ⑧ strategy of the whole thing, the foreman wrote in May, was one site and three shifts of measuring; strategy, he said, is either the load at the far ramp or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ strategy I remember is the plan measured in the sheet, which closed in 1982 and is still measured as the quietest in the site. A ⑩ strategy, my mother said in 1984, is the only plan that improves by being measured; every strategy, she said, is a wisdom that has agreed to look like a plan. She said the wisdom was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 策略（指工地里每一套旁边的那一套）
B. n. 策略（指那套策略本身，与短短的绳索相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the strategy 制定这一套策略
D. n. 策略（指留给孩子们抬的那一车）
E. n. 策略之事（抽象总称，指一处工地的策略之事）
F. n. 策略（指施工单里写到、被测量的那一套）
G. n. 策略、谋略（指一件事里人人都干却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 谋略（抽象总称，指人人都干却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the strategy that no worker in the site would have measured
The strategy, meaning the plan itself and not the rope
the strategy at the far ramp
the strategy was the whole of the matter
the strategy had become a line in a sheet
The strategy of the whole thing
A strategy, my mother said in 1984

answers.why: make the strategy 意为“制定这一套策略”，1975 年那位工头把工地里没有一位工人肯测量的一套策略做了一遍。
strategy 意为“策略”，指那套策略本身而不是短短的绳索，它经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被测量。
strategy 意为“策略”，指工地里每一套旁边的那一套，每一套旁边都有同一根短短的绳索。
strategy 意为“策略”，指最远那道坡台的留给孩子们抬的那一车，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
strategy 意为“策略、谋略”，指一件事里人人都干却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这套谋略就是那件事的全部。
strategy 意为“谋略”，指人人都干却无人提起的那样东西而不是那套策略，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
strategy 意为“策略”，指施工单里写到、被测量的那一套，到 1980 年这一套成了施工单里的一行。
strategy 意为“策略之事”，工头五月写道，整件事的策略之事是一处工地和三个班次的测量。
strategy 意为“策略”，我记得的是施工单里测量过的那一套，1982 年收工了，至今仍被说成工地里最安静的一套。
strategy 为抽象总称，母亲 1984 年说，策略是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的策略。
